tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Top of the cross-benchmark aggregate ranking: published Aggregate Ratings combine public benchmark evidence on one scale (call about_the_aggregate for the current coverage and method). One row per model by default, fused across reasoning-effort settings. Supports paging via limit/offset.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find ranked models by (partial) name or provider. Returns rank, Aggregate Rating and the model page URL. One row per model by default, fused across reasoning-effort settings.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model in depth: aggregate rank, Aggregate Rating with standard error, provider, what it is, cost per task where known, and its most notable benchmark results (with percentiles).

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Head-to-head between 2-4 models: aggregate ranks, rating gap with a significance note based on the standard errors, and notable benchmarks they share.

tools.name: search_benchmarks
tools.description: Find benchmarks in the aggregate by (partial) name. Returns model coverage, difficulty on the rating scale, and the benchmark page URL.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: One benchmark in depth: what it measures, the original source leaderboard URL, IRT stats (difficulty, noise, model coverage), skill weights, and the current top models on it.

tools.name: get_prediction_duel
tools.description: Guesswork — the public prediction duel: every day frontier LLMs and The Aggregate's own IRT model predict newly scraped benchmark scores before seeing them, and the errors are scored. Returns the current monthly standings, wins and losses included.

tools.name: about_the_aggregate
tools.description: What this data is: the published rating method, current coverage counts, update cadence, and how to cite it.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_models, search_benchmarks, get_benchmark · Public sink: compare_models.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_models, search_benchmarks, get_benchmark · Public sink: compare_models

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_leaderboard" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
